description: Test suite for parsing and encoding Slack modal private metadata, validating JSON handling, field filtering, and size constraints.

methods.name: parseSlackModalPrivateMetadata
methods.description: Parses JSON string to extract relevant Slack modal private metadata fields, returning an object with known keys or an empty object for invalid inputs.

methods.name: encodeSlackModalPrivateMetadata
methods.description: Encodes provided metadata fields into a JSON string suitable for Slack, excluding empty fields and throwing an error if size limit exceeded.
